content.short: StakeDAO academy is an end-to-end crypto and DeFi learning platform.
content.description: StakeDAO academy offers beginner to intermediate instruction across crypto and DeFi. Courses are created by a diverse team of authors from the StakeDAO community and are available in multiple languages. Topics span foundational definitions of Ethereum, Bitcoin, and Proof of Work to deeper discussions of synthetic assets and how DeFi options work. Users can filter the catalog to find courses that fit their interests, goals, and learning pace.
content.meta: StakeDAO academy is a learning platform for DeFi, crypto strategy, and onchain fundamentals. Discover StakeDAO academy and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
